name: software-factory
description: A team of subagents that turns a ticket or a goal into reviewed, merged work: plan, spec, build, review, UX review, approve.

interface.longDescription: Plans a ticket or goal, breaks big work into child tickets, writes a verified spec, builds it, reviews the code, commits and PR text before anything is pushed, checks pages in a browser, and merges low-risk work.
defaultPrompt: Use the factory to build a bookmarks app
